title: 第15章 没天理了第16章 突破气血中境
slug: 玄幻苟在深山打猎开局弟妹上门求肉
lines: 叶二狗举起棍子，照着王大山的脑袋就砸了下来。
这一下要是砸实了，非得头破血流不可。
后面的另外两个叶家人也紧跟其后。
面对这三人的围攻，王大山连躲的意思都没有。
他的眼神冷漠得可怕。
就在叶二狗的木棍即将落下的瞬间。
王大山动了，抬脚踹在了叶二狗的小腹上。
这一脚，他根本没有留手。
气血境武者的力量，毫无保留地宣泄而出。
叶二狗只觉得自己的肚子要爆开了，五脏六腑都跟着移了位。
一大口鲜血，直接从他嘴里喷涌而出。
他的身体再次像断了线的风筝一样，猛地倒飞了出去。
重重砸在了院子外面的雪地里，整个人蜷缩成一只煮熟的虾米。
跪在地上，捂着肚子，连惨叫都发不出来。
只剩下身体在剧烈地抽搐。
这一幕，发生在电光火石之间。
剩下的那两个叶家人，此刻已经冲到了王大山跟前。
手里的木棒硬生生停在了半空。
他们看着院子里生死不知的叶二狗，脑子里一片空白。
根本没给他们反应的时间。
王大山的身影已经如同鬼魅一般，欺身而上。
骨头断裂的声音，接连响起。
仅仅是几个呼吸的功夫。
两个五大三粗的汉子，就如同破布口袋一样，软绵绵地倒了下去。
趴在地上，连爬起来的力气都没有了。
此刻。
屋里站着的，除了王大山，就只剩下叶氏一个人了。
她傻眼了。
叶氏连连后退，最后被门槛绊了一下，一屁股跌坐在地上。
王大山一步一步朝她走去，没有半点怜悯。
反手就是几个响亮的耳光，结结实实的抽在叶氏的脸上。
这几下他控制了力道，没把人直接抽死。
但也足够让叶氏喝一壶的。
做完这一切之后，他拖着几个叶氏娘家的人。
大步走到门口。
就像丢垃圾一样，将他们狠狠的扔了出去。
接连几下。
叶家这几个兄弟，横七竖八地砸在了院子外面的雪地里。
最后。
王大山走回到叶氏面前。
content_en:
Ye Ergou raised his stick and hit Wang Dashan on the head.
If it hits hard this time, it will definitely result in a bloody head.
The other two Ye family members followed closely behind.
Faced with the siege of these three people, Wang Dashan didn't even have the intention to hide.
His eyes were terrifyingly cold.
Just when Ye Ergou's wooden stick was about to fall.
Wang Dashan moved and kicked Ye Ergou in the abdomen.
He didn't hold back at all with this kick.
The power of the Qi and Blood Realm warriors was unleashed without reservation.
Ye Ergou felt that his stomach was about to explode, and his internal organs were all displaced.
"Pfft."
A large mouthful of blood spurted out directly from his mouth.
His body once again flew backwards like a kite with its string broken.
It hit the snow outside the yard hard, and the whole person curled up into a cooked shrimp.
Kneeling on the ground, holding his stomach, he couldn't even scream.
All that was left was his body twitching violently.
This scene happened between lightning and flint.
The remaining two Ye family members had already rushed to Wang Dashan.
The wooden stick in his hand stopped abruptly in mid-air.
They looked at Ye Ergou who didn't know whether he was alive or dead in the yard, and their minds went blank.
They were not given any time to react.
Wang Dashan's figure was already like a ghost, stalking up to him.
The sounds of bones breaking sounded one after another.
Just a few breaths.
The two tall and thick men fell down limply like rag bags.
Lying on the ground, I didn't even have the strength to get up.
now.
Except for Wang Dashan, Ye was the only one standing in the room.
She was dumbfounded.
"You...you..."
Ye stepped back repeatedly, and finally tripped over the threshold and fell to the ground.
Wang Dashan walked towards her step by step without any mercy.
The backhand was a few loud slaps, hitting Ye's face firmly.
He controlled the force these few times and did not beat the person to death directly.
But it was enough for Ye to drink a pot.
After doing all this, he dragged several people from Ye's natal family with him.
He strode to the door.
Just like throwing away garbage, they were thrown out hard.
"Bang, bang."
Several times in succession.
The brothers of the Ye family were thrown into the snow outside the yard.
at last.
Wang Dashan walked back to Ye.
title_en: Chapter 15: There is no justice. Chapter 16: Breaking through the realm of Qi and blood.
